sourceNote: Prepared from ntpu_scholarship_source_links_for_codex_2026-06-30.txt. Do not import emergency aid as opportunity cards.
rules: source_url should point to the closest department or college official page.
official_url should point to the single scholarship page when available; otherwise use the scholarship index page.
If source_url is an index page, keep status as draft, needs_review, or needs_pdf_parse.
Do not create opportunity cards for 急難救助, 急難扶助, or 慰助金.
Do not infer department_limit or college_limit only from the website location.
Keep the formal scholarship title; do not add 公告, 辦理, or 相關訊息.
